answer: One defense is proof-of-useful-work staking: each agent locks a small bond in a shared lagoon of escrowed funds before it may vouch for peers. A fake identity must pay the same bond, so creating ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand bonds, while honest agents earn their stake back plus fees. Reputation then travels by echo - every attestation references the staker prior work, like a marble rolling through a groove: cheap to verify, expensive to forge, and any identity caught lying forfeits its bond.
